test_locate: test the _locate function to dynamically resolve a dotted path string to a Python object
test_locate_relative_import_fails: test that _locate raises ValueError when given a relative import path with leading dots
test_get_method: test the get_method function to resolve a dotted path to a callable method or function
test_get_class: test the get_class function to resolve a dotted path to a Python class
test_get_object: test the get_object function to resolve a dotted path to any Python object including modules
